mathematicalFormulas.shortageDeficit: ShortageQty[w] = SafetyStock - ProjectedBalance[w] (Triggered when ProjectedBalance[w] < SafetyStock)
mathematicalFormulas.recommendationScore: CompositeScore = (wCost * CostScore + wTime * TimeScore + wRel * ReliabilityScore) / (Sum of Active Weights)

verificationAssertions.rule: Shortage detection strictly respects time-phased weekly calendar buckets without double-counting received supply.
Inventory transfers cannot deplete source location below its dedicated safety stock threshold.
Expedited purchase orders must verify that expedited delivery date arrives strictly on or before shortage date.
Split shipments retain remaining non-expedited balance and do not exceed original order quantity.
Scoring algorithm does not inject arbitrary default constants (80, 75, 70) and dynamically renormalizes across present attributes.
